steps.text: Luminosity is the total power emitted; apparent brightness = L/(4πd²).
Double the distance and the brightness falls to one quarter.
Standard candles with known luminosity let us measure distance from brightness.
Redshift: receding sources shift lines to longer wavelengths, z = Δλ/λ.
Hubble's law: v = H₀d; more distant galaxies recede faster.
A straight-line v–d graph implies the universe is expanding uniformly.
